direction:
## Cover direction

**Design systems engineer:** Render the poster twice from the same content. One copy uses light colors and the other uses dark colors, and the two halves meet at x = 600. Every element keeps the same size and weight on both sides. The title crosses the seam, so each mode carries half of each word.

**Technical illustrator:** Check the title at 160 px wide first. Two lines, "Zero Hour" and "Rehearsal", at 132 px stay readable at that size. Use flat fills only, with no glow and no shadow. Leave only the title, the date, one line of task copy and the cue rail.

**Motion director:** Use the cue rail as the image: T-7d, T-1d, T-1h, T-60s, T-0, T+1h on one horizontal line. Show the resting frame at T-0 as "00:00:00", the one held moment before Live. All edges sit on a 4 px grid, and the rail runs exactly from margin to margin.

**Porcelain hare:** Recorded method: land a quick move without a second bounce. On the cover that becomes one red tick at T-0, drawn once, with no echo lines and no motion marks. Nothing else gets the accent.

**Lead's choice**

- **Composition:** A vertical seam at 600 px splits one poster into light and dark halves. The two-line title sits top left with 64 px margins and crosses the seam. The task line sits under the title. The cue rail spans the bottom at y = 520. The T-0 tick is the only tall mark, with "00:00:00" resting above it on the dark side.
- **Palette:** The light side uses paper #F2EFE8 with navy #0E2A47 ink. The dark side uses navy #0E2A47 with paper ink. The accent is Sam Creates red: #BE4D4D on light and #D9706A on dark, for contrast on navy. Muted text is #56687B on light and #A3B3C4 on dark.
- **Type:** The title uses Cover Headline at 132/122 px, weight 700, tracking −0.02em. The task line uses Cover Text at 24 px. The count uses Cover Headline at 40 px, weight 600, with tabular-nums. Cue labels and the date use Cover Text at 16 and 18 px. Sizes match in both modes.
